description: Read current Shopify price, currency, online inventory and backorder policy for an exact full SKU and quantity. Base-price arithmetic is not a binding quote; unverified volume terms require an RFQ. Optionally read an existing owner-authorized checkout for shipping/tax estimates. Creates no cart, checkout, order or RFQ.

checkout_access_token.description: Matching owner credential from create_checkout; never a Shop OAuth token.

checkout_id.description: Optional existing checkout to read; its single line must match this variant and quantity.

sku.description: Exact full variant SKU from resolve_lens_product.

variant_id.description: Optional Shopify Variant GID; must match the full SKU.

name: get_purchase_options
title: Check quantity purchase options
